register_sales_tax.title: Register for Washington Sales Tax
register_sales_tax.summary: FBA inventory or $100k+ sales (includes marketplace) creates nexus. Register for a sales tax certificate with WA DOR.

steps.title: Apply via WA DOR Business Licensing Service
steps.detail: Register online through the WA DOR Business Licensing portal. You will need your Federal EIN, LLC details, and estimated WA sales.
steps.verification_check: Receive a WA UBI number and sales tax certificate.

steps.title: Note filing frequency
steps.detail: WA assigns monthly, quarterly, or annual filing. Returns due the 25th of the month following the period. Combined return covers both sales tax AND B&O tax on a single form.
steps.verification_check: Filing frequency visible in My DOR account.

steps.title: Configure Shopify and update dashboard
steps.detail: Enable WA tax in Shopify. Amazon handles marketplace orders. Update Registrations page.

franchise_or_entity.title: Washington B&O (Business & Occupation) Tax
franchise_or_entity.summary: IMPORTANT: WA B&O tax is a gross receipts tax SEPARATE from sales tax. It is NOT covered by Amazon marketplace facilitator collection. FBA inventory creates B&O nexus. Retailing B&O rate is 0.471% on gross receipts.

steps.title: Understand B&O is separate from sales tax
steps.detail: B&O tax applies to your gross receipts from business in WA. Amazon handles sales tax collection, but B&O is your own obligation. The retailing B&O rate is 0.471%. Multiple classifications may apply.
common_pitfalls: Most commonly overlooked WA obligation for FBA sellers.
B&O applies even if Amazon collects sales tax.

steps.title: File B&O on combined return
steps.detail: B&O and sales tax are filed on the same combined excise tax return in My DOR. Due the 25th of the month following the period.

steps.title: Small business credit
steps.detail: The small business B&O credit offsets the first ~$125k/month in taxable income (effectively ~$250/month credit for retailing B&O). Most small sellers owe very little after the credit, but filing is still required.
steps.verification_check: B&O line shows on your combined return with credit applied.
